description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity named DetectorActivity. It implements real-time object detection using various models (TensorFlow Object Detection API, Multibox, or YOLO) and tracking. The class manages camera integration, image preprocessing, detection inference, and visualization of results. It references multiple external model files, utility classes, and Android UI components.

classes.name: DetectorActivity
classes.description: Android activity that performs object detection using TensorFlow models with real-time camera feed, including detection and tracking functionalities.

methods.name: onPreviewSizeChosen
methods.description: Initializes detection models, camera preview size, transformation matrices, and UI overlays when preview size is set.

methods.name: processImage
methods.description: Main processing loop called for each camera frame; handles image acquisition, detection, and tracking updates.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for the activity.

methods.name: getDesiredPreviewFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred camera preview frame size.

methods.name: onSetDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging for the detector.
